_howto: The departures board on the home page. Edit this file only; no code change is needed.
Rows appear top to bottom in this order. Row 1 is the signature: it says NOW BOARDING while the shop is open, FINAL CALL in the last half hour, and the real next opening time when closed.

status: one of on-time, seasonal, sold-out. What the tiles say comes from config/departures.js (by destination code) and the hours in config/ordering.js; seasonal adds SEASONAL to the row's sayings and sold-out shows SOLD OUT while the shop is open.

code + destination: the airport code and the place the category is inspired by. Local and American items fly HOU Houston. "TBD" means not decided yet: the board shows it as tbdShowsAs (HOU Houston) until it is.
description: one line, only what is true of every item in the category. Leave it "" if unsure; the board then points to the list in the shop.
items: the first three show under the category on the board; all of them show when the row is opened.

price: a number such as 5.5 shows as $5.50. Leave it null to show no price. The only prices in the code today are the demo placeholders in config/ordering.js, so every price here is null until the real menu arrives.
slug: used by links such as /menu/frappes. Keep it lowercase with dashes, and do not change the existing ones.
photo / photoAlt (category) and photo / alt (item): optional pictures for the /menu page. Leave them out and the page draws a boarding-pass plate instead. Only real photos of this shop's food.
This file is the one menu for the whole site: the homepage board and the /menu page both read it.
